verdict.rationale: Rollbar offers version/deploy tracking so you can see which code version is throwing errors (rollbar-docs-6, rollbar-docs-7) and pricing mentions 'sessions' as a metered unit (rollbar-docs-21), but there is no evidence of a dedicated release-health dashboard with crash-free session/user percentages or a canary-vs-stable comparison view. Missing for 10: crash-free session/user rate metrics, adoption-per-release charts, and canary-vs-stable comparison UI.
